The room was better than I expected for a 3-star hotel. The check-in process was very fast on arrival—it took only about one minute. The receptionist was extremely kind and helpful. There is a supermarket inside the hotel, and they can bring items directly to your room, which was really nice.

The suite room was very spacious and made me feel comfortable. However, there are still some areas that need improvement. The TV could be better, the floor felt a bit oily and not very clean, there were no slippers in the room, no bath robe, and no hair dryer provided.

The biggest issue was the bed mattress, it was extremely hard, like sleeping on a rock. I couldn’t sleep at all and ended up leaving around midnight to go home and sleep.
Please change the mattress.

We usually always booked at le park hotel but just yesterday Feb.15,2024, in the booking it's not said that parties are not allowed already so we booked for my birthday and celebrate it there, once I go for check in the reception tell me that parties not allowed already and if you reached 5 guest/visitors you need to pay additional of 150qr or another option will give you connecting room and pay additional 200qr, meaning we have 2 rooms to used because I have more visitors to come. When my visitors arriving they start counting the list until I reach 5 visitors they ask and always call that I should pay extra for additional visitors coming for 150qr. It's my first time knowing about this new rules that's i should pay when have visitors coming but knowing they will not stay in our rooms only to eat and chat and bond then going home. So it's so confusing why we need to pay extra for having more than 5 visitors and give limited visitors. After end of the day of staying I was waiting for the receptionist to ask about our extra payment but when we check out there was no extra bill need to pay and knowing already have another staff duty and not the one always calling for us and ask for extra payment for having more than 5 visitors. End up I will not booked here anymore though we love the place but this kind of experience will never be tolerated. Keep an eye of those staff. Scammers
